prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity 2.5D game enemy animation sprite sheet. Input image is ONLY the identity/silhouette and exact VIEW direction reference. Redraw this same Tank, not a new creature. Materials: matte dark rock brown armor, warm gray-white sinewy limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style matching AlienPurge. Camera fixed elevated 45 degrees, soft upper-left light. Massive squat broad quadruped with thick layered irregular rock-brown armor boulders, huge pale gray sinewy muscular FOUR legs, blunt low armored head and amber eye slit, broad heavy body. Preserve the reference's wide tank silhouette. No green/red/purple dorsal sacs, no extra limbs or spikes.
CRITICAL DIRECTION: RIGHT profile facing screen right, nose at right edge of body and tail at left; keep this exact direction in EVERY pose, no turns.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR columns and 6 rows, 24 separate full character drawings. PORTRAIT canvas with width:height ratio 4:6, each equal square cell contains one complete creature within its central 70%, generous fully transparent gutters all around. No silhouettes touch, no cropped feet, no detached bits. Read frames left to right then top to bottom. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential heavy WALK frames, four legs take distinct weight-bearing steps, alternating diagonal pairs, subtle weight shift, stable armor. Row3: FOUR IDLE breathing poses, planted feet. Row4: FOUR shockwave WINDUP frames: hind legs brace, front limbs and chest gradually lift a little, ready to pound ground, preserve full anatomy. Row5: FOUR SLAM/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame both front feet firmly strike ground with head lowered, then armored body absorbs impact, shoulders recoil and settles; no drawn shockwave, dust, debris or ground. Row6: FOUR DEATH frames, heavy legs progressively lose support, armor settles flat, head rests, amber eye darkens.
Every frame holds the EXACT SAME camera direction, identity, proportions, four legs and plate count. Real joint motion, no duplicate frames or whole-body-only transforms. Anchor feet at the same baseline and body at same center in each cell. Empty pixels true alpha 0, including holes between legs; no solid background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text/labels/grid, no VFX/projectiles. Render clean silhouette edges.
